moments.title: Jungle calling: I'm A Celebrity returns!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! kicks off on Monday, November 16th, with a star-studded line-up heading into the Australian jungle.

angles.name: Line-up reveal
angles.copy: Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, Ricky Wilson, Chloe Burrows… the I'm A Celeb line-up is officially OUT! Who are you backing to be King or Queen of the Jungle?

angles.name: Kiosk Kev twist
angles.copy: Hold up! Kiosk Kev is 'working from home' this year, with treats delivered to a new British red post box. What twist will the jungle throw next?

angles.name: Get ready for Monday
angles.copy: Monday night plans? Sorted! I'm A Celebrity is back tomorrow at 9pm. Get ready for bushtucker trials, campfire drama, and Ant & Dec's iconic banter.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Week 8 Results
moments.blurb: The Strictly Come Dancing Week 8 results show airs tonight, with one couple facing elimination just a week before the iconic Blackpool ballroom special.

angles.name: Tonight's tension
angles.copy: It's results night on Strictly! Who will be dancing their last dance before Blackpool? Tune in at 7:15pm to find out! #Strictly

angles.name: Leaderboard toppers
angles.copy: Cach Mercer and Maddie Ingoldsby topped the leaderboard with a near-perfect 39 points in Week 8! Can they avoid the dance-off tonight?

moments.title: Premier League: Liverpool vs Man Utd
moments.blurb: One of English football's fiercest rivalries reignites as Liverpool host Manchester United at Anfield on Sunday, November 22nd.

angles.name: Massive match-up
angles.copy: It's the ultimate showdown next Sunday! Liverpool vs Manchester United at Anfield – who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: Rivalry week
angles.copy: The build-up begins for Liverpool vs Manchester United on November 22nd. Which team needs the win more?

moments.title: Wales host Australia in Rugby Nations Championship

angles.copy: Principality Stadium is set for a massive one next Saturday! Wales go head-to-head with Australia in the Autumn Nations Series. How loud will the roar be?

angles.name: Dragon's roar
angles.copy: All eyes on Cardiff next Saturday! Our boys in red face the Wallabies. Who's making the trip to cheer on Wales?

moments.title: England vs All Blacks at Twickenham
moments.blurb: England face the mighty All Blacks at Twickenham on Saturday, November 21st, in a highly anticipated Autumn Nations Series clash.

angles.name: Twickenham showdown
angles.copy: England vs the All Blacks at Twickenham next Saturday! This is going to be HUGE. Prediction time: who comes out on top?

angles.name: Autumn Series heat
angles.copy: The Autumn Nations Series delivers another blockbuster: England vs New Zealand. Can England upset the odds?

moments.title: Lauren Price defends world titles in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Welsh boxing sensation Lauren Price defends her IBF, WBA and WBC women's welterweight titles in Cardiff on Friday, November 20th.

angles.name: Cardiff champion
angles.copy: Our very own Lauren Price is defending her world titles in Cardiff this Friday! Get behind the Welsh champ! #Boxing

angles.name: Home advantage
angles.copy: Welsh boxing hero Lauren Price fighting on home turf this Friday. Who's ready to see her dominate?

moments.title: Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to the iconic Las Vegas Strip for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, with practice starting Friday, qualifying Saturday, and the race Sunday, November 22nd.

angles.name: Lights, Camera, F1!
angles.copy: It's almost race week in Vegas! F1 hits the Strip this weekend for the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Expect glitz, glamour, and high-speed drama. #F1 #LasVegasGP

angles.name: Who will conquer Vegas?
angles.copy: The Las Vegas Grand Prix is just days away! Can anyone challenge the favourites on this unique street circuit?

moments.title: Nitto ATP Finals in Turin
moments.blurb: The Nitto ATP Finals, featuring the world's top tennis players, runs from today, November 15th, to November 22nd in Turin, Italy, with British players in the doubles.

angles.name: Tennis season finale
angles.copy: The Nitto ATP Finals kick off today in Turin! Catch the world's best battling it out for the year-end title. Who's your pick?

angles.name: British doubles hopes
angles.copy: Look out for British talent Henry Patten and Neal Skupski in the doubles at the ATP Finals this week! Fingers crossed for a strong run!

moments.title: James Blunt tops UK Albums Chart
moments.blurb: James Blunt's new album 'Airplane Mode' has soared straight to number one on the UK Official Albums Chart, his first chart-topper in nearly two decades.

angles.name: Blunt's back at No.1
angles.copy: He's done it again! James Blunt's 'Airplane Mode' is the UK's number one album. What's your favourite track from the new record?

angles.name: Two decades later
angles.copy: From 'You're Beautiful' to 'Airplane Mode', James Blunt proves he's still got it, landing his first No.1 album in almost 20 years!

moments.title: Jamie Miller 'Babydoll' still UK No.1
moments.blurb: Welsh artist Jamie Miller's hit single 'Babydoll' holds strong at number one on the UK Singles Chart for a fourth consecutive week.

angles.name: Welsh chart dominance
angles.copy: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is STILL the UK's number one song! Big love for our Welsh talent keeping that top spot! #JamieMiller

angles.name: Four weeks strong
angles.copy: A month at number one for Jamie Miller! 'Babydoll' shows no signs of slowing down. What's your favourite lyric?

moments.title: UK Christmas Markets are bustling!
